final: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(spatial_count) AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT c.fundflux, c.spatial_count, 1.0 * c.spatial_count / t.total_count AS share, c.spatial_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE c.spatial_count > t.average_count
